composite_narrative.en: The composite index is 62.9, an unweighted average across 5 domains. 4 of 5 domains show a monitor-level or strong fragility signal: External stability, Liquidity, Rates & monetary policy, Prices.

composite_narrative_stakeholder.es: Varios de los indicadores que monitorea este panel muestran cierta inestabilidad reciente, aunque no de forma generalizada. Es un momento para seguir de cerca la evolución, no para sacar conclusiones todavía.
composite_narrative_stakeholder.en: Several of the indicators this panel tracks show some recent instability, though not broadly across the board. This is a moment to keep watching closely, not to draw conclusions yet.

narrative_stakeholder.es: El dinero en circulación está creciendo y moviéndose de forma cada vez menos predecible. Esto es justamente la preocupación pública más común sobre política monetaria — vale la pena vigilarla, aunque por sí sola no confirma que vaya a haber más inflación.
narrative_stakeholder.en: Money in circulation is growing and behaving in an increasingly unpredictable way. This is exactly the most common public concern about monetary policy — worth watching, though on its own it doesn't confirm that more inflation is coming.

narrative_stakeholder.en: Interest rates are behaving in an increasingly unpredictable way. This can make loans, mortgages, and variable-rate credit more expensive — it's the signal in this panel most directly tied to people's day-to-day finances.
